character.description: Accepted Pixel Night Shift sprite artist identity: compact chibi operator with asymmetric magenta beret and attached cyan digital stylus.

idle.action: subtle breathing and one soft blink; the asymmetric beret, cyan stylus, hands, and planted feet stay stable; frame four returns naturally toward frame one

upgrade.action: clear creative-tool upgrade gesture with planted feet and the same broad body scale as the idle anchor: neutral start, draw the attached cyan stylus inward to focus, lift it decisively as the torso rises, then finish in one confident upgraded pose; preserve the rectangular apron pocket, tiny cyan-magenta pins, round cyan eyes, bare ears, and asymmetric beret in every frame; absolutely no earring, ear ring, hair ornament, logo, circular emblem, detached effect, extra accessory, or thinner redesign

style: Match the accepted canonical base exactly: original Pixel Night Shift compact chibi sprite_artist, asymmetric raspberry-magenta beret, attached bright-cyan digital stylus, purple work apron, midnight-navy clothes, cool pale face, crisp chunky pixel clusters, restrained existing dark outline, limited ten-color target palette, no extra equipment or redesign.
